scientific_integrity: Proof and deterministic exact finite checker are included; enumeration supplements rather than proves the unbounded theorem. Self-review only, no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: At most three voters and unit-binary additive approval utility; fixed-cardinality committees. No claim for larger electorates, general valuations, variable budgets or other committee constraints. The full text of the directly related fractional Pareto optimality study was not accessible; equivalent claims in uninspected portions remain a priority risk.
title: Four universal approval scores certify Pareto efficiency with three voters
